newsitem.title: CHINA: China First Pencil says rights issue approved.
newsitem.headline: China First Pencil says rights issue approved.

text.p: China First Pencil Co Ltd said on Tuesday its planned three-for-10 rights issue had been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
The company would shortly issue a prospectus on the issue, it said in a statement carried in the Shanghai Securities News.

The offer, approved by shareholders in September 1996, would be priced between 2.33 yuan and 2.5 yuan, and proceeds would be used to develop a line of cosmetic pencils, water-soluble paints and pencil sharpeners, the firm said earlier.
China First Pencil reported a net profit of 42.123 million yuan in 1995 by international accounting standards, up 27.9 percent from 30.329 million yuan in 1994.
The company has yet to post 1996 results. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
